followingTitle: You get a notification for every message here
notFollowingTitle: You left this channel — only mentions notify you here
emptyTeamOnly: Nothing here yet. This channel is only for the team — it never reaches a client.
placeholder: Message the team — # cites a card, @ names somebody
withdrawBody: It stops showing in the channel for everyone.
clientSeesBody: This came from the team's channel, which the client never sees. Making the card visible puts it on their board and spends one of their ticket numbers.
